answer: Each period agents submit a signed spiral‑indexed reputation hash to a juniper‑seeded ledger, then whisper their graded scores to a random subset of peers. Peers recompute mutual information of the received score vectors; if a panel’s joint entropy stays below a threshold for three consecutive periods, the system flags the group as a Sybil cluster. To create N fake identities an attacker must lock up stake equal to 10 × N tokens for each epoch and wait 3 epochs before the hashes become usable, otherwise the low‑entropy trigger ejects them.
